dataset_a_vedo_ocr.name: VedoOCR — Vedic Sanskrit Manuscript OCR Dataset
dataset_a_vedo_ocr.intended_role: Source manuscript images, character/word visual patterns, baseline OCR evaluation, and source for controlled synthetic degradation pairs.

dataset_b_sanskrit_hindi_vqa.name: Sanskrit and Hindi OCR VQA Dataset
dataset_b_sanskrit_hindi_vqa.intended_role: Document images and textual Q&A annotations for contextual text prediction and Devanagari OCR evaluation.

synthetic_data.name: Past2Pixel Controlled Synthetic Degradation Pairs
synthetic_data.intended_role: Clean vs Degraded training pairs with ground-truth damage masks.
